title: Law to require on-street trash bins at city buildings
summary: This bill would direct the Department of Sanitation, working with the Department of Citywide Administrative Services and the Department of Education, to create a program requiring city-owned non-residential buildings to dispose of waste using stationary on-street containers rather than loose bags. Buildings with off-street collection, such as those with loading docks, would be exempt. All covered city buildings would need to comply by June 1, 2030, and the Department would have to report on implementation plans and costs.
